an3.92:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tīṇimāni bhikkhave, kassakassa gahapatissa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:1.3: idha bhikkhave, kassako gahapati sīghasīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ.
an3.92:1.4: sīghasīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ sīghasīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti.
an3.92:1.5: sīghasīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā sīghasīghaṃ udakaṃ abhinetipi apanetipi.
an3.92:1.6: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:1.7: tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave, kassakassa gahapatissa natthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā,
an3.92:1.8: ajjeva me dhaññāni jāyantu sveva gabbhīni hontu, uttarasveva paccantūti.
an3.92:1.9: atha kho bhikkhave, hoti so samayo. yaṃ tassa kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni utupariṇāmīni jāyantipi gabbhīnipi honti paccantipi.
an3.92:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, tīṇimāni bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:2.4: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
an3.92:2.5: tassa kho taṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno natthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā,
an3.92:2.6: ajjeva me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatu sve vā uttarasve vāti.
an3.92:2.7: atha kho bhikkhave, hoti so samayo, yaṃ tassa bhikkhuno adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an3.92:3.2: tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne. tibbo chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāneti.
